data.overview: MAC Cosmetics, owned by The Estée Lauder Companies, is consistently rated poorly on animal welfare by independent reviewers: PETA lists it as a company that tests on animals, and Good On You, Conscious Bunny and Bunny Search all flag it as not cruelty-free, largely due to sales in markets where animal testing may be required by law. Sustainability raters give mixed-to-poor scores, crediting some ingredient commitments, FSC packaging and a Back-To-MAC takeback program, while noting reliance on virgin plastics and animal-derived ingredients such as lanolin.

claims.claim: MAC states it commits to avoiding certain ingredients such as parabens and microplastics to reduce its environmental impact.
claims.quote: MAC Cosmetics has committed to avoid certain ingredients to lower its environmental impact , including parabens , phthalates , other petrochemical -based ingredients , uncertified palm oil
